gloss: putting in a good word, recommendation

definitions.gloss: putting in a good word, recommendation, intercession
definitions.explanation: Speaking favorably on someone's behalf to a person of influence, in order to help them gain a favorable outcome.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口添|くちぞ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いした→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧。
examples.english: I asked the teacher to put in a good word for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口添|くちぞ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was hired thanks to the department head putting in a good word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知人|ちじん}→知人：04056_chijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口添|くちぞ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んで→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧、⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I asked an acquaintance to put in a good word and got an interview opportunity.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth, words) + ⟦{添|そ}え→添う：13344_sou⟧ (adding, accompanying)

Literally "adding words" — speaking supportively on someone's behalf.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {口添|くちぞ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put in a good word
- {口添|くちぞ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask someone to put in a good word
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{口添|くちぞ}えで: thanks to ~'s recommendation

USAGE:
Implies using personal connections or influence to help someone. In Japanese society, where personal networks (⟦{人脈|じんみゃく}→人脈：18253_jinmyaku⟧) play an important role, {口添|くちぞ}え is a recognized and valued form of social support, though in formal contexts it can overlap with concepts of favoritism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口添|くちぞ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いする→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧: to ask for a recommendation (polite)
- {口添|くちぞ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: thanks to someone's good word
- {口添|くちぞ}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask for a good word
